name: Carolineskolen
siblingDiscount: 50% discount automatically applied if the family has three or more children enrolled at the school ("Har I tre eller flere børn på skolen, får I automatisk 50% i søskenderabat")
profile: Denmark's only Jewish school ("Danmarks eneste jødiske skole"), located in Østerbro, Copenhagen. Combines a standard Danish curriculum with a dedicated Jewish profile (Jewish studies, Hebrew, traditions) alongside strong arts/music offerings.
curriculum: Danish (with Jewish studies/Hebrew as part of profile)
notes: Fee is flat per child per month regardless of grade (not tiered by grade). July is fee-free. No enrollment fee or waitlist details found on the site; could not access the dedicated admission/enrollment page (404). Affiliated with Det Jødiske Samfund (the Danish Jewish Community).

name: Christianshavns Døttreskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1900 kr/month; 3rd child: 1600 kr/month; 4th child: free
profile: Founded 1799, originally a girls' school ("Døttreskole"), today a co-ed classic Copenhagen private school in Christianshavn emphasizing well-being, academics and 'dannelse' (character formation), with traditions like morning singing and annual school plays.
curriculum: Danish (Folkeskolens Prøver / FP9 exams after 9th grade)
waitlist: Uses external waitlist platform ventelisten.net (school code 101079); no indication of current wait times.
notes: A deposit equal to one month's tuition is charged before school start, refunded when all school books are returned after 9th grade. Twice yearly (Feb & Aug), 100 kr paid to class funds (klassekasser). Enrollment fee waived for younger siblings of current students. Max class size ~24, ~300 pupils total.

name: Det Kgl Vajsenhus Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 75% of fee; 3rd child: 50% of fee; 4th child: free
profile: Historic Copenhagen private school (founded as the Royal Orphanage, 'Det Kongelige Vajsenhus'), with longstanding Christian traditions and ties to Helligåndskirken (confirmation offered), but functions today as a classic academic private school ('det hele menneske' - educating the whole person).
waitlist: Waitlist registration open from birth/CPR number issuance for 0. class; places for 0. class allocated by waitlist priority considering siblings already enrolled, scholarship requests, time on list, and gender balance. Mid-year vacancies via waitlist + trial week.
notes: Fee tiers by grade: 0.-3. kl. 1,680 kr/md; 4.-6. kl. 2,100 kr/md; 7.-9. kl. 2,300 kr/md. No fees charged in July. Enrollment fee (2,000 kr for 0. class) becomes a deposit after 1 October. School has a program to fund free places (friplads) for 25-30% of pupils via proceeds from hymnbook sales, per a Kristeligt Dagblad article, once a multi-year transition completes.

name: Institut Sankt Joseph
siblingDiscount: Danish dept: 2nd child 25% off (~512 kr/md); 3rd child 50% off (~1,030 kr/md); 4th child free. (International Bilingual dept has separate, higher deposit/discount structure - see notes.)
profile: Catholic school (160+ years tradition) in Copenhagen offering a humanistic, international and caring environment. Runs two parallel tracks: a standard Danish-language department and an International Bilingual Department (BI) taught partly in English/French, plus a music school and a 10th grade international class.
curriculum: Danish (Dansk Afdeling) and separately an International Bilingual curriculum (BI department)
gradesOffered: 0-10 (Danish dept 1.-9./10., plus international 10th grade; bilingual dept overlapping grades)
waitlist: Waitlist registration requires a non-refundable application fee (500 kr for Danish dept; 2,000 kr for International Bilingual dept).
notes: International Bilingual Department (BI) fee for 2026/27: 3,460 kr/month (12 months = 41,520 kr/year); deposit of two months' tuition for first child, one month for subsequent children; sibling discounts same % structure as Danish dept but off the higher base. An older English page (sanktjoseph.dk/en/tuition-and-fees/) quoted 2025/26 International dept fees of 3,420 kr (1st child)/2,565 (2nd)/1,710 (3rd) plus SFO 1,610 kr - these are prior-year figures superseded by the 2026/27 Danish-language page used as primary source here. SFO monthly figure (1,750 kr) is specifically for grades 1-2 per the Danish dept table. Financial aid ('tilskud til skolepenge') available for children from kindergarten through 9th grade. Note: a separate, unrelated Catholic school 'Skt. Josefs' (sktjosef.dk) and 'Sct. Joseph Søstrenes Skole' appeared in search results but are NOT this school - not included here.

name: Sankt Ansgars Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,320 kr/month; 3rd child: 990 kr/month; 4th child: free
profile: Catholic-Christian private school ('the little secure village school') in the heart of Nørrebro, Copenhagen, with roots to a school opened in 1742 alongside the Catholic Sankt Ansgar Church. Explicitly inclusive of families 'with faith and without'; over 25 nationalities and multiple religions represented among pupils.
curriculum: Danish (English from 1st grade, German and French offered from 5th grade as subjects)
waitlist: Registration ('Opskrivning til Sankt Ansgars Skole') page exists; specific current wait times not found. Fripladser (free/subsidized places) available via annual application.
notes: Fee page did not state which school year the 1,650 kr/month figure applies to, nor any enrollment/registration fee - could not confirm these despite multiple fetch attempts. Morning care ('Morgenåbent') costs 150 kr/month, but a full SFO monthly price for 0.-3. class was not found on the pages checked. If a student withdraws mid-year, fees are due for the withdrawal month plus the following month.

name: Krebs' Skole
siblingDiscount: None - "Der ydes ingen søskendemoderation" (no sibling discount offered)
profile: Classic Copenhagen private school founded in 1872, emphasizing a solid academic foundation in a secure setting, with numerous long-standing school traditions.
waitlist: For 0. class, waitlisted families receive a letter in September the year before school start to confirm interest; classes composed by following January. For grades 1-9, vacancies trigger an initial orientation conversation with school leadership, followed by an intake interview with Danish/math teachers before admission.
notes: SFO pricing is tiered: morning care (07:00-08:35) 470 kr/md; afternoon care (13:40-16:00) 1,420 kr/md; extended afternoon (13:40-17:30) 1,710 kr/md; minimum monthly SFO payment is 940 kr. A 3,000 kr deposit is required at enrollment (in addition to no sibling discount, one of the pricier options among the six schools on a per-month basis when deposit is included).

name: Freinetskolen
siblingDiscount: Up to 25% reduction on fees for the 3rd and subsequent child in families with 3+ children enrolled simultaneously, applied via the school's internal reduction fund.
profile: A small independent 'lilleskole' in Valby, Copenhagen, following Freinet pedagogy (after French educator Célestin Freinet) with child-centred, workshop-based learning, ecological values, and school democracy (plenum meetings).
notes: Fee is tiered by grade: kindergarten class (0.) through 3rd grade = 2,275 DKK/month (used here, applies to 1st grade); 4th-9th grade = 2,775 DKK/month. Fee includes mandatory organic/ecological lunch. Billed 12 months/year, last payment in July. Separate 'Pasning' (before/after-school childcare, SFO-equivalent) = 500 DKK/month for 12 months. Enrollment deposit = 2 months' ordinary fee (currently 5,550 DKK), refunded on withdrawal. 2 months' written notice required to withdraw. Prices page appears to show a rate increase effective 1 April 2026 (previous rate was 2,175/2,675 per an earlier cached search snippet).

name: Vanløse Privatskole
profile: A private primary/lower-secondary school ('privatskole') in Vanløse, Copenhagen, offering instruction from kindergarten class through 9th grade. No distinctive pedagogical movement (e.g. Freinet, Montessori, Grundtvig-Kold) was found described on available pages; appears to be a general/traditional Danish private school with an after-school club called 'Labyrinten'.
notes: Could NOT find published fee figures despite extensive search. The school's real site (www.vanloeseprivatskole.dk / vanloeseprivatskole.dk) redirects into a Skoleporten-hosted portal (vanloeseprivatskole.skoleporten.dk); the specific 'Skolepenge.htm' and 'Værd at vide.htm' pages both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated fetching (likely blocked/JS-gated), and third-party aggregators (privateskoler.dk, skolegang.dk, kobenhavnliv.dk price-comparison article) reference the existence of fee info but did not surface the actual numbers in accessible text. Confirmed via skolegang.dk that the school teaches through 9th grade (203 students, average exam grade 9.6/12, well above national average). Do not guess the fee — recommend contacting the school directly (adm.101135@vanloeseprivatskole.dk / 38 71 56 85) or viewing the Skolepenge page in a real browser. Not to be confused with the separate, differently-named 'Vanløse Friskole' (vanloesefriskole.dk), which is a different institution.

name: Trekronergade Freinetskole
siblingDiscount: Sibling reduction available for families with 3+ children enrolled simultaneously (amount not specified); the one-time enrollment fee is halved for siblings (500 DKK vs 1,000 DKK).
profile: A small Freinet-pedagogy school centrally located in Valby, Copenhagen (210 students), emphasizing both academic and creative development of 'the whole child' through democratic, age-integrated workshop-based learning (groups named Ild, Jord, Luft for grades 1-6). Mobile-phone-free school.
curriculum: Danish (Folkeskolens Afgangsprøve after 9th grade); English taught from grade 3, German from grade 6
waitlist: Kindergarten-class admission is via lottery draw held in November; one-time waitlist registration fee of 300 DKK for grades 1-9.
notes: Flat monthly fee of 2,275 DKK stated (no grade tiers mentioned, unlike sister-tradition Freinetskolen in Valby which tiers by grade at the same 2,275 DKK rate for grades 0-3). Fee is said to cover all materials, after-school program access, annual trips (grades 1-9), and a travel/music festival for grades 7-9 — so SFO appears to be bundled into the fee rather than charged separately (could not confirm a separate SFO price). Number of monthly billing installments per year not explicitly stated on the page (paid via PBS); left as null rather than assumed. Separate one-time kindergarten-class deposit of 3,000 DKK (refunded when the child leaves). Financial aid/subsidy applications available via the school office.

name: Ryparken Lille Skole
siblingDiscount: Roughly 55% reduction for siblings: 1,012 DKK/month (grades 0-3) or 1,246 DKK/month (grades 4-7), versus the full 2,280/2,539 DKK rates.
profile: A Copenhagen 'lilleskole' (reform-pedagogy free school) in the Ryparken/Østerbro-Nørrebro area, founded in 1983 by teachers and parents, with the motto 'Lev livet' (Live life). Emphasizes democracy and student meetings, the 'Mantle of the Expert' teaching method, and theatre as part of the curriculum.
waitlist: Operates an admissions/waitlist system for kindergarten-class entry; specific acceptance rates or current waitlist length not published.
notes: Fee is tiered: grades 0-3 = 2,280 DKK/month (used here, applies to 1st grade); grades 4-7 = 2,539 DKK/month. Billed in 12 installments per school year. Note the school only goes through 7th grade (confirmed via enrollment-by-class-level data: classes exist for levels 0-7 only, ~173-560 students depending on source/year), so pupils transfer elsewhere for 8th-9th grade — unusual among the schools researched. Enrollment fee 1,750 DKK is non-refundable.

name: DIA Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: -400 DKK/month; 3rd child: -600 DKK/month; 4th child: -900 DKK/month; 5th child: -1,400 DKK/month (all relative to the 1,550 DKK base rate).
profile: A Muslim/Islamic-profile private school on Nørrebro, Copenhagen, operating since 1981, serving roughly 350-430 students through 9th grade with a largely bilingual student body (most from Arabic-speaking backgrounds). Known for strong exam results and high progression to secondary/gymnasium. Core stated values: 'ansvarlighed, engagement og faglighed' (responsibility, engagement, academic rigor).
curriculum: Danish (Folkeskolens Afgangsprøve); supplementary Arabic-language books/instruction for grades 0-6
notes: School fee billed in 11 installments/year (not 12). Separate one-time deposit of 1,500 DKK charged with the first invoice, plus a 200 DKK/year charge (each September) for Arabic books, grades 0-6. SFO (after-school care) is 750 DKK/month, billed over 12 installments, with optional holiday care at 150 DKK/child for autumn, winter and summer breaks. Note: an earlier general web-search snippet (not from the school's own site) cited slightly different figures (1,400 DKK base fee, 800 DKK SFO) — the numbers above come directly from the school's own 'Praktisk info' page and are treated as more authoritative. Fee page did not state which school year the rates apply to. Note also: DR/Danish press has reported regulatory disputes over the school's certification in the past (see 'Styrelse: DIA Privatskole skal miste retten til at drive friskole'); current operating status as of 2026 was not verified beyond the school's own live website.

name: Bjørns Internationale Skole
siblingDiscount: English department: 2,100 DKK/month for 1st child, 2,000 DKK/month for 2nd child, 1,900 DKK/month for 3rd+ child.
profile: An international independent school in Copenhagen (Gartnerivej 5), established 1967, with about 160 students from 50+ nations. Runs parallel departments: an English Department (Cambridge International curriculum leading to IGCSE, plus some Danish-curriculum subjects like PE, Danish as a second language) and a Danish Department (Pre-school to grade 9). Member of ECIS and an IGCSE examination centre.
curriculum: Cambridge International / IGCSE (English Dept.); Danish national curriculum (Danish Dept.)
gradesOffered: 0-9 (English Department spans grades 1-9; Danish Department spans Pre-school/0 through grade 9)
waitlist: Families apply and pay an application fee to secure a waiting-list position; seniority on the waitlist matters but is not the sole admission criterion — class social dynamics and overall fit are also considered.
notes: Fees already in DKK, no currency conversion needed. Figures are somewhat inconsistent across sources: the monthly figure used here (2,100 DKK/child, English Dept., ~2025/26) comes from third-party aggregators (edarabia, ischooladvisor) citing the school's own published rates; a more recent third-party source (international-schools-database.com) instead lists an annual flat rate of 27,700 DKK/year for grades 1-10 for 2026/27 (≈2,308 DKK/month), which may reflect a fee increase or apply to a different department. The school's own official fee table ('Financial Overview' at biscopenhagen.com/information/finacialoverview) is published only as an image/PDF and could not be read by automated fetching — recommend the parent view it directly in a browser to confirm the current exact rate and which department it covers. One-time enrollment fee is 7,000 DKK per family; a refundable deposit of one month's fee is also payable on entrance; a 100 DKK/child administration fee applies; children in EC/ED/EE pay an extra 800 DKK/year for Danish and French materials.

name: Hovedstadens Privatskoler, Filipskolen
siblingDiscount: Fee decreases per additional child: tuition grades 0-3 ranges 1950 (1st child) down to 1350 DKK/month; grades 4-9 ranges 2050 down to 1450 DKK/month. SFO/club full-time 1225 (1st child) down to 1125 DKK; part-time flat 975 DKK.
profile: Christian free school (kristen friskole) on Amager Strand, member of the Association of Christian Free Schools (FKF); over 50 years old, ~200 students grades 0-9. Open to all regardless of church affiliation; values Christian faith, formation ('dannelse'), learning and well-being.
waitlist: Waiting list open from birth for børnehaveklasse (0th grade), which starts May 1 each year; registration fee 500 DKK. Mid-year transfers into existing classes possible via screening + 2-4 week trial period.
notes: Fees are tiered by grade band (0-3 vs 4-9) and by sibling order (1st/2nd/3rd child); page explicitly labeled these as 2025/2026 prices (site had not been confirmed updated for 2026/27 as of research, Sept 2026). September billing includes an extra 250 DKK contribution to the class fund. Withdrawal mid-year incurs the withdrawal month's fee plus one additional month. The dedicated 'Skolepenge.html' page on the school's SkolePorten subdomain (filip-skolen.skoleporten.dk) returned server errors (403/500) throughout research and could not be directly verified; figures above come from the 'Bliv elev' (Become a pupil) page on the main site.

name: Amager Lilleskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 562 DKK/month reduction; 3rd child: 1125 DKK/month reduction (applied to the flat 2440 DKK/month tuition).
profile: A 'lilleskole' (progressive alternative free school) on Amager with ~300 students, grades 0-9 (mostly single-track). Strong emphasis on community, artistic-creative subjects (music, choir, textiles, art, drama, PE, swimming), and project-based/thematic teaching, including whole-school annual projects and workshop weeks. Runs an attached music school (ALMUS).
waitlist: Waiting list system with cohort-by-cohort status; lists for children starting 2020-2022 were closed (full); lists for 2023/2024/2025 starts were open with roughly 100/85/30 children registered respectively at the time those figures were posted. No 2026/2027 status was found on the page (site may not yet reflect current cohort), so current waitlist length is uncertain.
notes: Tuition (Bh.kl-9. klasse) is a flat rate, not tiered by grade; rate is adjusted annually on 1 January (current rate '1,940->2,440' effective 1 Jan 2026, i.e. spans the second half of school year 2025/26 and first half of 2026/27). SFO/'Klubben' (Bh.kl-3) is billed over 11 installments (Aug-June) rather than 12. Extra costs: ALMUS music program 50 DKK/month; camp/study trips 800-3,500 DKK depending on grade/destination; 7-9 grade music/theater festival ~1,000 DKK. Late payment fee 100 DKK + interest; early withdrawal without notice penalized 3 months' tuition+club fees. Payment only via Betalingsservice (direct debit).

name: Byens Skole
siblingDiscount: None found/mentioned.
profile: A 'lilleskole' (progressive free school) in Valby with 450+ students across two tracks, grades 0-9. Pedagogy blends academic competence with development of students' critical thinking, motivation, personal expression and agency; draws on learning-by-doing and anti-authoritarian progressive-education traditions.
waitlist: School maintains waiting lists; has a dedicated 'Indmeldelse - udmeldelse og ventelister' (enrollment/withdrawal/waiting lists) page. Both an enrollment fee and a separate waiting-list fee are charged; exact current wait times not stated on the fee page.
notes: Fees are tiered by grade band: 0-3 = 1,765 DKK/month; 4-6 = 1,870 DKK/month; 7-9 = 2,635 DKK/month. SFO (0-3) = 870 DKK/month; 'Klub' (4-6) = 765 DKK/month (no club/SFO listed for 7-9). Fees stated as effective '1. august 2025'; the school's stated policy is a 3% increase each August, so 2026/27 rates are likely slightly higher but an updated page could not be found as of research (Sept 2026). Deposit at enrollment equals one month's tuition/SFO payment, in addition to the 1,000 DKK non-refundable enrollment fee. Fees are stated to cover schooling, books/materials (excluding dictionaries, calculators, computers), field trips/lejrskole, and a meal ('madordning') arrangement.

name: Øbro Fri Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 500 DKK/month reduction on tuition.
profile: Montessori-inspired free school in a courtyard setting in Østerbro ('Østerbros hyggeligste baggårdsskole'), founded by teachers drawing on Maria Montessori's ideas about building children's self-confidence and sense of responsibility. Small, close-knit school with open classrooms, motto 'Live life - Learn life', strong emphasis on teacher-student relationships, security and anti-bullying culture.
waitlist: Open enrollment with multiple spots currently available in 0. klasse (kindergarten class) and some vacancies in other grades; waiting-list registration for incoming 0. klasse via MitID at ventelisten.net. School holds open-house events/school visits for interested families.
notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: The school's own fee page (on the skoleporten.dk subdomain) returned repeated errors (HTTP 403, then 500) on every direct fetch attempt during this research; the figures above come from a search-engine cached snippet of that page, dated 'as of 1 January 2025'. Given today's date (Sept 2026), these figures may be outdated (the school may have since updated rates); they could not be independently re-verified. Camp school (lejrskole) costs are billed separately, not included in the monthly fee. Grades offered listed as '0-8' based on found references (student quotes up to '8. klasse'); it is possible the school actually extends further and this simply reflects available page content - treat as unconfirmed. Recommend contacting the school directly to confirm current fees before making decisions.

name: Landsbyskolen
siblingDiscount: Sibling discount available but conditional on concurrent enrollment of siblings ('Søskenderabat er betinget af samtidig skolegang'); non-first children pay 1,650 DKK/month vs 2,000 DKK for the first child (exact discount mechanism/amount not further itemized).
profile: Independent Danish free school ('friskole') founded in 1974, non-affiliated with any religious or political movement, ~145 students, grades 0-9. Emphasizes respect for each pupil's individuality/abilities, small classes, community responsibility, and a daily 'Læsebånd' (dedicated reading period). Recognized by CEPOS for strong academic value-added. Became a fully independent self-governing institution in August 2023.
waitlist: Waiting list open from birth; registration fee 300 DKK plus 100 DKK/year to remain listed (charged Sept/Oct). Siblings get priority; ~16 children accepted per kindergarten class, with gender balance considered. Currently only a few open spots exist, in 8th grade. NOTE: the school had no 0th-grade ('0. klasse') intake in 2023/2024, which means there is correspondingly no 1st class in 2024/25, no 2nd class in 2025/26, no 3rd class in 2026/27, etc. - i.e. a gap moves up through the grades; families registered for those specific cohorts could get waitlist-fee refunds.
notes: Enrollment cost of 5,900 DKK breaks down as: 4,000 DKK deposit (= 2 months' tuition) + 1,900 DKK one-time enrollment fee. Fees billed monthly in advance over 11 months (not 12). Means-tested fee subsidies available based on prior year's tax return, must reapply annually. Camp/school-trip ('lejrskole') fees charged separately, ranging ~50-650 DKK/month depending on grade, spread across tuition bills. Figures above are explicitly labeled by the school as applying to school year 2026/2027.

name: Nørrebro Lilleskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: tuition 1,612.50 DKK/month (537.50 DKK discount), SFO 1,050 DKK/month (350 DKK discount). 3rd+ child: tuition 1,075 DKK/month (1,075 DKK discount), SFO 700 DKK/month (700 DKK discount). Waitlist fee (500 DKK) is waived for siblings of current pupils.
profile: Free school ('fri grundskole') in the Nørrebro lilleskole tradition, humanistic and critical pedagogical outlook, ~200 pupils grades 0-9 organized into cross-grade tiers: Stjerneskuddet (0-3), Nymånen (4-6), Fuldmånen (7-9), plus Galaksen SFO (0-3 after-school program). Emphasis on 'forpligtende fællesskaber' (binding/committed communities).
waitlist: Annual information evening for prospective 0th-grade families each Oct/Nov (next one stated as 3 November 2026); class composition decided in November. Admission priority: siblings first, then waiting-list seniority. Classes capped at 20 pupils (kindergarten class starts with up to 24). Waiting list for existing classes must be reconfirmed annually by email or the family is removed.
notes: Fee period explicitly stated on page as running 1 Aug 2026 - 31 Jul 2027 (i.e. current, 2026/27 rates). Unlike some peer schools, camp/lejrskole contributions are already built into the monthly school fee rather than billed separately. Registration/enrollment: 1,000 DKK one-time enrollment fee plus a separate 500 DKK waitlist fee (waived for siblings). Families may apply for government means-tested subsidy ('Fripladsordning').

name: Sankt Annæ Skole
siblingDiscount: 3rd child: 1,075 kr/month (500 kr reduction vs. 1st/2nd child); 4th child: free, as long as all four siblings are enrolled simultaneously.
profile: A Catholic private school on Amager, founded in 1897 by Redemptorist priests under Bishop von Euch. This institution (sanktannaeskole.dk) is NOT the music/choir profile school - that is Sankt Annæ Gymnasium (sag.dk), a separate, unrelated public/municipal institution in Valby famous for its choirs. Sankt Annæ Skole does run its own small in-house 'musikskole', but its defining identity is Catholic, and admission explicitly prioritizes Catholic applicants and siblings.
waitlist: Registration on the waiting list costs 300 DKK. Class composition is finalized roughly one year before school start, with priority given to siblings and Catholic applicants, then by seniority (with attention to gender balance). Students not admitted can remain on the waitlist for 100 DKK/year.
notes: Fees billed in 12 monthly installments, due the 5th of the month. 10th grade billed separately at 2,400 kr x 10 installments. SFO is 1,400 kr/month over 12 installments, with May and June free for 3rd-graders. Enrollment fee of 1,000 DKK is charged only once a spot is offered (separate from the 300 DKK waitlist registration fee). Fee is stated to include several field trips (2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th grade trips, including Bornholm and Rome). IMPORTANT: do not confuse with Sankt Annæ Gymnasium (music/choir school) - a different institution.

name: Bordings Friskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,545 kr/month; 3rd child: 515 kr/month. Discount only applies if fees are paid by the same parent (and, for half-siblings, if they share a registered address).
profile: A Grundtvig-Kold friskole (Danish independent free school in the Grundtvig-Kold tradition) with grades 0.-9. klasse, roughly 420 pupils across two parallel tracks (as of Sept 2024).
waitlist: Admission to grades 1-9 goes through an electronic waitlist (ventelisten.net). Kindergarten (0. klasse) has about 44 places per year, with priority for siblings.
notes: 9th grade is billed differently: 2,248 kr/month over 11 installments (July is fee-free after exams), instead of the standard 12-month schedule. Enrollment fee of 200 DKK is an administrative charge for joining the waitlist, not a one-time indskrivning fee.

name: Den Lille Skole i København
siblingDiscount: A sibling discount is offered per the school's own materials, but the exact percentage/amount could not be confirmed.
profile: A small free school ('lilleskole') located in Brønshøj, Copenhagen, and a confirmed member of Lilleskoleforeningen, the Danish association of reform-pedagogy free schools (in the tradition of e.g. Nørrebro Lilleskole, Østerbro Lilleskole). Grades and detailed pedagogy statement could not be independently confirmed on the school's own site during this research.
waitlist: Joining the waiting list costs a non-refundable 600 DKK administrative fee. A separate non-refundable 3,500 DKK enrollment fee is charged after an admission interview once a place is offered.
notes: The school's fee page (on skoleporten.dk, linked from lilleskolen-kbh.dk) returned HTTP 403 to direct automated fetching; the figures above were recovered via a search-engine snippet of that exact page ('Den Lille Skole i København - Opskrivning og priser') and could not be re-verified directly or dated to a specific school year - recommend confirming directly with the school before relying on these numbers. Monthly school fee: 2,035 kr over 12 months. SFO/'fritidshjem': 1,724 kr/month over 11 months (no charge in July). Do not confuse with the separate, differently-named 'Den Lille Skole' (no 'i København'), which has different fees (~2,130 kr/month school, ~1,340 kr/month SFO) and is a different institution.

name: N. Zahles Seminarieskole
siblingDiscount: No sibling discount is offered as of 1 August 2025 (previously offered, now discontinued).
profile: One of several independent primary schools operating under the shared 'N. Zahles Skole' name/heritage (tracing back to Natalie Zahle's 1851 girls' school and the 1895 teacher-seminary practice school). Academically classic/traditional, co-educational since the 1950s, with stated values of democracy, equality, creativity, community, tradition, dialogue and responsibility; daily morning singing is a school ritual.
waitlist: Website references an 'Indskrivning' (enrollment) process; specific waitlist length/criteria were not found.
notes: IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION: 'N. Zahles Skole' / zahles.dk is a shared portal/brand for legally separate institutions: (1) N. Zahles Seminarieskole (seminarieskolen.zahles.dk) - this institution, id 101088, a standalone grundskole (0.-9. klasse) descended from the seminary's practice school; (2) N. Zahles Grundskole, run as the 'Grundskoleafdeling' of N. Zahles Gymnasieskole (grundskolen.zahles.dk) - a separate primary school with its own institution number (101155, covered separately in this dataset, sharing identical published fee figures); (3) N. Zahles Gymnasium (gymnasiet.zahles.dk) - separate upper-secondary (STX) school. Fee also includes 28 kr/month parent-council charge and 50 kr/month fruit scheme; a 75 kr/month surcharge applies if not paying via PBS direct debit.

name: Sankt Petri Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 2,300 kr/month; 3rd child: 1,725 kr/month; 4th child and beyond: free.
profile: A bilingual Danish-German school for the German-Danish community in Copenhagen, founded in 1575, with roughly 600 pupils. German and Danish have equal status as languages of instruction from 0. klasse; the school combines German and Danish curricula, concluding grundskole with both FP9 (Danish) and a German Sek1 examination, and continues into an upper-secondary track (10.-12. klasse) giving access to further study in both Denmark and Germany. English starts in grade 3, French is an elective from grade 6.
curriculum: Danish + German (dual curriculum; German Sek1 and Danish FP9 exams)
waitlist: An admissions process exists; no specific waitlist duration/criteria was found on the school's public pages.
notes: The school's own '/da/priser/' page turned out to cover only its affiliated Sankt Petri Musikskole (instrument lessons: 790-1,800 kr/month, 350 kr enrollment), not general school tuition - general tuition figures above came from the '/da/indmeldelse/' (enrollment) page instead. A separate, non-official web search additionally surfaced a grade-tiered fee table (2,525 / 2,200 / 1,625 / 0 kr per month) that could not be reconciled with the child-order-based table above; the 0 kr tier plausibly reflects the state-funded gymnasium level (10.-12.) rather than a grundskole grade. Treat the 2,625 kr figure (1st child, own-site source) as the more reliable current figure for a new 0./1. class pupil, but this tiering ambiguity should be verified directly with the school. Additional charges: 1,100 DKK registration fee alongside the 2,200 DKK grade-0 enrollment fee; 200 kr/family annual school-association membership; optional after-school 'Klub' at 900 kr/month (9,900 kr/year).

name: Østerbro Lilleskole
siblingDiscount: 25% discount on the youngest child's fee when siblings are enrolled together.
feeYear: 2024/25 (last rate confirmed on the school's own site, effective from 1 August 2024)
profile: A free school ('fri grundskole') in the Danish reform-pedagogy 'lilleskole' tradition (confirmed member of Lilleskoleforeningen), emphasizing community, creative/practical/musical learning, and project-based, interdisciplinary teaching. Grades 0.-9. klasse, with roughly 22-24 pupils per class.
waitlist: As of the research date, the school listed a few open spots for the 2026/27 school year (e.g., 3rd grade girls, 8th grade, and two anticipated 7th-grade spots); families are asked to contact the school directly for current waitlist status.
notes: The 2,980 kr/month egenbetaling (own-payment) figure is an ALL-INCLUSIVE fee covering school, SFO/club, and field trips for younger grades - there is no separate published SFO line item, hence sfoMonthlyDKK is null (bundled, not absent). Billed over 11 months (no charge in July). A 1,000 DKK non-refundable enrollment fee and a 6,000 DKK deposit (credited toward the family's final months of attendance) are also charged at enrollment. The site states fees rise annually per Denmark's net price index with a 2.5% minimum increase, so the true current (2025/26 or 2026/27) monthly fee is likely somewhat higher than 2,980 kr, but no more recent figure was published on the site as of this research.

name: Ingrid Jespersens Gymnasieskole
siblingDiscount: Full discount (no fee) from the 4th child onward attending simultaneously; applies to the lowest-fee child. No explicit 2nd/3rd-child discount found.
profile: Historic private school on Østerbro, Copenhagen (roots to the late 1800s) combining a gymnasium-preparatory grundskole with its own upper-secondary gymnasium (STX). Classical, academically oriented profile with a strong instrumental-music program; most grundskole pupils progress directly into the school's own gymnasium.
curriculum: Danish (folkeskole-equivalent grundskole feeding into STX gymnasium)
waitlist: Operates a waiting list; a separate kr. 400 fee applies to be placed on it (per aggregated search results, not independently re-verified on-page).
notes: monthlyFeeDKK (2,275 kr) is the flat grundskole ('Primary school') rate — not tiered by individual grade, so it applies equally to 1st grade. Gymnasium rate (1.g-3.g) is 1,835 kr/month (2,235 kr/month for the Rhythmic Line). Deposit of 6,000 kr is non-refundable if withdrawn before the school year starts. SFO is 1,910 kr/month billed over 10.5 months (includes fruit); a morning-care-only SFO option costs 165 kr/month. A prior year's figures (~1,810-2,210 kr/month) were seen in an aggregated search snippet and appear to be 2025/26 rates, superseded by the 2026/27 figures used here. Source PDF: datocms-assets.com/55959/1778497825-betalingsbetingelser-2026.pdf

name: Niels Steensens Gymnasium
siblingDiscount: 20% off for a 2nd concurrently-enrolled child, 40% off for a 3rd and subsequent children.
profile: Jesuit-run Catholic private school on Østerbro, Copenhagen, now officially named 'Niels Steensen Grundskole og Gymnasium.' Grundskole covers 6th-10th grade only, feeding into the school's own gymnasium (STX). Rooted in Jesuit/Catholic values but open to pupils of all faiths.
curriculum: Danish (grundskole 6.-10. klasse feeding into STX gymnasium)
notes: IMPORTANT: this school does not offer 1st grade at all — its grundskole spans only 6.-10. klasse, so 1,725 kr etc. figures used for other schools' '1st grade' do not apply here. monthlyFeeDKK (2,225 kr) is therefore the fee for 6th grade, the lowest grade actually offered, not literal '1st grade.' 10th grade (G10) costs 2,800 kr/month (includes study trip). Gymnasium (1.g-3.g) costs 1,800 kr/month. A separate refundable 2,000 kr deposit is required in addition to the 2,000 kr non-refundable enrollment fee. Also charged: ~35 kr/month/family 'solidarity fund' and a 200 kr class-fund fee twice yearly (Aug & Jan). Means-tested fee subsidies available for household income under ~403,585 kr/year (2025 threshold). Task's given name 'Niels Steensens Gymnasium' is outdated (now 'Niels Steensen Grundskole og Gymnasium'); website www.nsg.dk confirmed correct.

name: N. Zahles Grundskole
siblingDiscount: None — sibling discount was abolished as of 1 August 2025 ('Der ydes fra 1/8 2025 ikke længere søskenderabat').
profile: The Grundskoleafdeling (primary-school department) of N. Zahles Gymnasieskole in central Copenhagen — a classic, academically oriented private grundskole feeding into the school's own gymnasium. Historically descended from Natalie Zahle's 1851 girls'-education/teacher-training foundation.
notes: AMBIGUITY: The task-given website www.zahlesgym.dk could not be fetched directly (repeated SSL handshake failures), but search results confirm it is a portal titled 'Zahles – Vælg mellem grundskolen og gymnasiet' (choose between the grundskole and the gymnasium) that routes to grundskolen.zahles.dk and gymnasiet.zahles.dk — this record uses grundskolen.zahles.dk as the best match for institution 101155 'N. Zahles Grundskole.' There is also a separately-numbered 'N. Zahles Seminarieskole' (id 101088, seminarieskolen.zahles.dk) descended from the same historical Zahle foundation. ALL published fee schedules across the Zahle family of schools are IDENTICAL (2,400 kr/month, 11 months, SFO 1,800 kr/month, no sibling discount since 1/8/2025), suggesting shared/linked administration despite being legally/numerically distinct institutions. Given the identical published figures, the fee data above should be reliable regardless of institutional identity nuances.

name: Kildeskolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,415 kr/month; 3rd child: 1,110 kr/month; 4th child: 805 kr/month (SFO sibling rates: 900/760/615 kr/month respectively).
profile: Private friskole (grades 0-9) in Valby, Copenhagen. Uses L. Ron Hubbard's 'Study Technology' method (from the book 'Lær Hvordan Man Lærer'), part of the Applied Scholastics movement — the same core pedagogical licensor used by Amager's International School. Combines individualized, self-paced study with collective/thematic teaching (discussion, projects, democracy/culture themes); max 20 pupils/class.
curriculum: Danish (FP9 national exit exam); school also mentions offering 'tosprogsundervisning' (bilingual/EFL-type support) without further detail.
notes: Applied Scholastics / Hubbard 'Study Technology' is the same movement associated with Scientology-linked licensing (as also documented for Amager's International School) — worth flagging for a parent screening for this. In addition to the 1,725 kr one-time enrollment fee, the school also collects a separate 1,725 kr deposit (indskud) plus the first month's tuition at signup (total upfront ~5,175 kr before ongoing monthly fees); unclear whether the deposit is refundable. An earlier, likely outdated aggregated search snippet cited slightly different figures (1,695/1,390/1,090/790 kr and SFO 1,025 kr over 11 months) — the numbers above come from a direct fetch of the school's own current payment page and are treated as authoritative.

name: Amager's International School
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: -100 kr (1,600 kr/month); 3rd child: -400 kr (1,300 kr/month); 4th+ child: 1,100 kr/month.
feeYear: 2025/26 (site states pricing effective 'februar 2025'; no newer figure found as of research date Sept 2026)
profile: Private friskole (grades 0-9), founded 30 April 1985. Despite the 'Amager' name and the input's listed municipality, the school is now physically located in Rødovre (confirmed address: Rødovrevej 395, 2610 Rødovre) — the Rødovre municipality listing in the input is correct; the name is a historical holdover from its Amager origins. Uses L. Ron Hubbard's Applied Scholastics/Study Technology method, licensed from a Scientology-affiliated organization per Danish Wikipedia. Ranked #2 nationally (#1 in Copenhagen) by the CEPOS think tank in 2022 for teaching effectiveness, ~200 pupils.
curriculum: Danish, with Applied Scholastics/Study Technology methodology overlay
waitlist: A meeting with school leadership is required before enrollment is possible; families can be placed on the waiting list while awaiting that meeting.
notes: Enrollment fee (2,400 kr) is 50% refundable if the pupil withdraws within the first 6 months. SFO fee is 850 kr/month full-time (8+ hrs/week) or 650 kr/month part-time, for grades 0.-3. School describes itself as 'international' with pupils from many countries, but Danish is the language of instruction per available content — no separate English/bilingual instruction track was found.

name: Jinnah International School
siblingDiscount: Built into the base rate as a per-child tier: 930 kr (1st child), 830 kr (2nd), 730 kr (3rd), 630 kr (4th).
profile: Danish-Pakistani independent school in Copenhagen (Vanløse), describing itself as offering 'a good and safe school experience in caring surroundings,' inspired by founder Muhammad Ali Jinnah's philosophy. Integrates the Danish grundskole curriculum with Urdu-language study and Islamic religious instruction, and celebrates both Danish and Pakistani holidays/traditions.
curriculum: Danish (FP9 national exit exam) + Urdu (required subject) + Islamic studies
waitlist: Waiting lists exist for most grades; 0th-grade applicants sit entrance exams in November, other grades are tested as spots open; admission priority goes first to siblings of current pupils, then by exam performance/waitlist duration.
notes: The task-given website www.jinnahschool.dk does not appear to be the school's real domain — its actual official site is jinnahskole.dk (Danish 'skole', not 'school'); could not confirm whether it redirects. School year for the fee figures was not stated on the page (data reflects the live site as of Sept 2026, so likely 2026/27). SFO (550 kr/month) and bus service (300 kr/month) are billed over 11 monthly installments (vs. 12 for core tuition). Optional organic-fruit fee: 30 kr/month/child. A 150 kr surcharge applies if paying by invoice instead of PBS direct debit.

name: Det Frie Gymnasiums Grundskole
profile: The grundskole ('Dragen') of Det Frie Gymnasium is a grassroots-democratic overbygningsskole (only 8.-10. klasse) founded 1985, tightly linked to progressive 1970s 'free school' pedagogy — students co-decide teacher hiring, rules, and school life at biweekly meetings; not a religious school.
waitlist: Long waitlist for 8th grade; also long for 10th grade; 9th-grade admission currently closed. Apply via ventelisten.net/101170, then a motivated application and interview. Prior German/French since 5th grade and physics since 7th grade typically expected.
notes: IMPORTANT: this school has NO 1st grade — it only teaches 8.-10. klasse (its gymnasium/HF programs for older students are a legally separate offering with their own, higher fees: STX 1.g 1985/md, 2.-3.g 1920/md; HF 1.HF 2020/md, 2.HF 1920/md, also 12 months, July-June). monthlyFeeDKK here uses the lowest grundskole tier (8.-9. klasse = 2220 kr/md, incl. intro trip/study tours/meals); 10. klasse is 2470 kr/md. Prices rise 100 kr/year each July 1. Two months (July+Aug) prepaid at enrollment (deposit-like, not a separate registration fee). Støttekreds (support circle) 200 kr/year deducted in December. No sibling discount found. Not a suitable choice for a family seeking a 1st-grade place.

name: Ahi International School
siblingDiscount: Fee is tiered by total children enrolled from the family, not a % discount: 1 child 850 kr/md, 2 children 1600 kr/md total, 3 children 2500, 4 children 3150, 5 children 4000/md.
profile: Private primary school in Vanløse founded 1988; despite the 'International' name it teaches in Danish and follows Danish curriculum/law. Serves a majority bilingual/immigrant-background student body (~29% ethnic Danish per 2023/24 stats) and frames its mission around integration while 'respecting each student's right to preserve their language, culture and religion.' No explicit Islamic/Muslim branding was found on the school's own pages.
waitlist: Free waitlist registration; admission via close dialogue with family; 0. klasse decisions given Dec 10-15 for the following August start.
notes: SFO fee 650 kr/md for 0.-3. klasse, over 11 months; fruit scheme 25 kr/md (school) / 50 kr/md (SFO) over 11 months. One-time costs: admission test 250 kr + registration/enrollment 500 kr + book deposit 500 kr per child. Income-based fee reduction available via application by Sept 1 each year. Base tuition's 11-month billing is inferred from the surrounding fee schedule (all stated 'from 1 Feb 2025'), not explicitly spelled out for the base tuition line itself. A 2026 comparison article (danmarksdagblad.dk) independently lists this school at the same 850 kr/md 'youngest grades' figure, corroborating the amount.

name: Lygten Skole
siblingDiscount: Per-child tiers (school fee): 1st child 1650 kr/md, 2nd 1235, 3rd 825, 4th+ free. SFO: 1st child 1100, 2nd 825, 3rd 550.
profile: Christian-ethos friskole in København NV built around 'barn først, elev bagefter' (child before pupil); emphasizes emotional safety/wellbeing as a precondition for learning, small classes (~22), tolerance/diversity as core values, an integrated music program (BeatLab), and a FOKUS track for 7.-9. klasse that includes a humanitarian trip to Cambodia. Runs its own attached kindergarten (børnehave) and nursery (vuggestue).
waitlist: No specific wait-time published; enroll via email to the office (kontor@lygtenskole.dk); one month's written notice required for enrollment/withdrawal changes.
notes: FOKUS-skolepenge for 7.-9. klasse is a separate 1800 kr/md tier (covers 3 class trips), replacing the standard per-child fee for that stage. 'Summer children' (transitioning into school in May-July) pay 1900 kr/md including SFO. Extra 'Hyggeren' program is 600 kr/md over 11 installments. SFO billed over 11 installments (vs. school fee's 12). Pedagogy tagged 'grundtvig-kold' as best fit for a liberal, child-centered Christian-humanist Danish friskole tradition — not explicitly labeled as such by the school itself, so treat as an inference.

name: Al Hikma Skolen
profile: Danish independent school founded 1993 in Copenhagen, historically serving children of Iraqi-Muslim heritage; describes itself as Islamic-inspired ('religion, in our case Islam, is a private matter at school') while explicitly drawing on both Islamic teaching and the Danish Grundtvig-Kold free-school tradition. Instruction blends Danish and Arabic; core values are community, democratic citizenship, academic excellence, and bicultural (Iraqi-Arab-Islamic/Danish) identity; mostly ethnically-Danish teaching staff to bridge students to Danish society.
waitlist: No formal waitlist; annual application window (Sept-Dec) for the following August start; entrance assessment/interview Feb-March; admission decisions Mar-Apr. More applicants than spots, so acceptance is not guaranteed even if criteria are met (Arabic as home language/support required; parents must support school's values).
notes: School fee billed 12 months/year including July, via PBS only. One-time deposit of 4800 kr (~3 months' fee) in addition to the 1000 kr enrollment fee (charged once per child for their whole time at the school). Material costs 700 kr charged twice yearly (Aug + Jan); class fund 700 kr in November. 9th grade is a special case: its annual fee (19,200 kr, i.e. same as 1600x12) is instead spread over 11 monthly payments of ~1745.45 kr rather than 12.

name: Hay Skolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child 1600 kr/md (225 kr less than 1st), 3rd+ child 1350 kr/md (450 kr less).
profile: 'HAYSKOLEN - en levende skole' ('a living school'), a private free school in the Sydvestkvarteret area of Copenhagen SV. No explicit religious affiliation or named pedagogical tradition (Grundtvig-Kold, Montessori, etc.) was found on the school's own site — appears to be a general, non-denominational lilleskole-type friskole, but that tag is a best inference rather than a confirmed label.
waitlist: Admission tested/decided 4x/year (weeks 35, 50, 14, 25). Priority: (1) siblings registered by Oct 1 before the school year starts, (2) waitlist time (days since birth registered), balanced for gender mix, (3) school-readiness testing; final call by the headmaster. Apply via ventelisten.net/101181.
notes: Billed 11 installments Aug-June (July fee-free). SFO: 2nd+ child 600 kr/md each. Førskole (pre-0.klasse) 2500 kr/md incl. SFO 7:30-17:00. Summer SFO 600 kr/week. On top of the 1500 kr enrollment fee there is a 3700 kr deposit (~2 months' tuition, refundable on withdrawal after 0.klasse if paid up) and a separate 300 kr waitlist administration fee. Class trip surcharges: grade 5 Bornholm trip 400 kr x3, grade 8 international trip 400 kr x11. Prices are indexed annually each Aug 1, rounded to nearest 50/100.

name: Sjællands Privatskole
profile: Friskole in København NV (Nattergalevej), ~200 pupils, grades through 9th; notably diverse student body (41.3% with 'foreign background' in 2023/24 vs ~15% nationally), suggesting an immigrant-community-oriented friskole, but no specific religious affiliation (Muslim, Christian, etc.) or pedagogical tradition (Montessori, Waldorf, etc.) could be confirmed from any accessible source.
notes: DOMAIN VERIFICATION: spsnet.dk is confirmed to be Sjællands Privatskole's genuine website — it iframe-redirects to spsnet.skoleporten.dk, and contact details there (phone 3833 4727, email sps@spsnet.dk, Nattergalevej 32) match official records for institution 101184, so the domain is correct, NOT misidentified. However, spsnet.skoleporten.dk is protected by a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge that blocked automated fetching, so the school's own priser/skolepenge and optagelse pages could not be read directly. The 800 kr/month (8800 kr/year) figure and grade range instead come from a third-party news comparison article and general directory listings (uddannelsesstatistik.dk, dingeo.dk, skoleliste.eu) — none state a school year for the fee explicitly; 8800/800=11 suggests 11-month billing but this is inferred. No SFO price, enrollment fee, sibling discount, or explicit pedagogy/religious profile could be found anywhere accessible. Recommend the parent visit spsnet.dk directly in a real browser (passes the Cloudflare check) or call 3833 4727 to confirm current tuition and profile.
